title: Firetower Center

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Moore Farms’ Fire Tower Welcome Center is the perfect location for your next corporate event, meeting, bridal/baby shower, or wedding rehearsal/reception. Offering four rental spaces surrounded by beautiful landscapes and unique artistic elements, the Fire Tower Welcome Center was completely renovated in 2022 to provide our guests with a modern, southern atmosphere. These spaces feature four handicap accessible restrooms, 3 smart TVs, 2 catering/prep kitchen options, and more. Parking attendants, outside rental reservations, tables, and chairs are optional inclusions with your booking, upon request. ‍Please note: We do not currently allow wedding ceremonies on the property. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The annual ArtFields Festival, dubbed the South’s premier art festival, calls Lake City home-and Moore Farms Botanical Garden is ready to welcome you! During the Garden Open - ArtFields Festival, you can explore our 65-acre garden in multiple ways, but the Guided Tour offers a truly immersive experience. Led by our expert horticulturists, daily tours at 10:30am reveal the garden’s history, design process, and unique plant collections, while giving you the chance to interact with the landscape artists themselves. Guests will also enjoy our outdoor art collection, featuring over 40 works from past ArtFields competitions, commissioned projects, and in-house creations-all included for just $5.
